verdict.rationale: Greptile documents custom rules for team-specific issues, configurable through greptile.json or uploaded style guides, and it can import plain-language AI rules files such as CLAUDE.md and AGENTS.md. Since it automatically reviews every PR, team-defined natural-language standards are applied on each PR. However, the evidence frames these rules as review comments, not discrete pass/fail pre-merge checks, and nothing shows checks like 'docs updated' or 'tests cover new paths' being supported. Missing for 10: explicit confirmation that rules are written in plain language, check-style pass/fail status or merge gating per rule, examples of doc- or test-coverage checks, independent hands-on corroboration.
